name: SP1 Stage 2 — Revision may dismiss a critic finding instead of acting on it

scenarios.name: CRDismiss-01 RevisionDelta carries dismissed_gaps alongside the existing delta fields

steps.text: the RevisionDelta Pydantic model is defined
the model has a <delta_field> field of type list
the RevisionDelta Pydantic model is defined
a RevisionDelta is constructed with no arguments
the RevisionDelta dismissed_gaps list is empty

scenarios.name: CRDismiss-03 a dismissal-only revision leaves the control structure intact

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta whose only content is <dismissal_count> dismissed gaps
the revision is run
the final control structure contains RESP-1
the final control structure contains RESP-2
the final control structure responsibilities count is 2
the pipeline does not crash

scenarios.name: CRDismiss-04 each dismissal justification is reported in the warnings

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta dismissing a gap with the justification "the system has no multi-agent capability"
the revision is run
the warnings list includes a warning that mentions "the system has no multi-agent capability"
the warnings list includes a dismissal warning

scenarios.name: CRDismiss-05 a revision with no dismissals reports no dismissal warning

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with new_responsibilities containing RESP-3 with valid PM, CA, and FB elements
the revision is run
the final control structure contains RESP-3
the warnings list does not include a dismissal warning

scenarios.name: CRDismiss-06 additions and dismissals can coexist in one delta

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with new_responsibilities containing RESP-3 with valid PM, CA, and FB elements and one dismissed gap
the revision is run
the final control structure contains RESP-3
the warnings list includes a dismissal warning

scenarios.name: CRDismiss-07 revision_user.j2 offers the add-or-dismiss choice

steps.text: the template revision_user.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "<fragment>"

examples.fragment: dismiss it with a one-sentence justification
target capabilities the system does not have

scenarios.name: CRDismiss-08 revision_user.j2 no longer mandates an element per finding

steps.text: the template revision_user.j2 is loaded
the template text does not contain "You MUST add at least one element for EACH finding"

scenarios.name: CRDismiss-09 revision_system.j2 documents the dismissal rule

steps.text: the template revision_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "<fragment>"

examples.fragment: You may DISMISS a finding if you judge it to be a false positive

background.text: the STPA system model critic module is importable
a control structure with responsibilities RESP-1 and RESP-2 is available
CriticFindings with unjustified gaps are available
a run directory for call logging
